quests.title: Before They Touch the Marrickville Metro
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. They start on the Marrickville Metro on Sunday and the orange fencing goes up. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I want Marrickville on record before it does. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: photograph the state of the Marrickville Metro
then the other end of it

quests.title: Two From Hellenic Bakery
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Two of whatever's going near Hellenic Bakery, here, hot, before the footy at eight at night. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. It's Marrickville; I'm not asking for much. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: pick up two from near Hellenic Bakery

quests.title: Trolley Run, Hellenic Bakery
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. A Woolies trolley from Hellenic Bakery gets walked to the creek every Wednesday. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Find where it ends up in Marrickville and make the deposit back. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: find the trolley near Hellenic Bakery

quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Henson
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The site at the Henson starts its jackhammer at bin night on a Saturday, which is illegal and loud. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Photograph it running and have a word with the Marrickville foreman. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: photograph the noise from the Henson
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Something From the Henson
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The stall at the Henson has run out and the customers keep coming. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Find something round Marrickville that'll do before the five rush. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: pick something up near the Henson

quests.title: The the Cooks River Order
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. The the Cooks River order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by ten past ten. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Find seventy in Marrickville and photograph the receipt. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Cooks River order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: Proof of the Cooks River
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Nobody in Marrickville believes what the Cooks River looks like at closing. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: get a picture of the Cooks River before they fix it

quests.title: Left It Near the Cooks River
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. I left something on the bench at the Cooks River at lunchtime. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. By the time I got back to Marrickville it had walked, so look where I'd have dropped it. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: check the bench near the Cooks River

quests.title: Lads Off Marrickville Bowlo
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Three of them in TNs on the Marrickville Bowlo steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at knock-off. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Marrickville used to move them on itself and now it rings me. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: move the lads on from Marrickville Bowlo
